name: supabase
description: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.
one_liner: A ready-made backend for apps — database, logins, file storage, and APIs — so a small team can launch a web or mobile app without building server infrastructure from scratch.
buyer: A first-time founder or indie developer who wants to ship a working app MVP in weeks, not months, without hiring a backend engineer.
business_use_cases: A solo founder builds and launches a SaaS MVP's entire backend (auth, database, file uploads) in a weekend instead of hiring a backend contractor.
A mobile app studio standardizes on Supabase across client projects so every new app reuses the same auth and database patterns, cutting delivery time.
An aspiring AI founder bolts on Supabase's vector/embeddings toolkit to add AI search to a product without learning a separate vector database.

money_ideas.idea: An agency sells fixed-price 'MVP in 2 weeks' packages built entirely on Supabase, pocketing the margin between the flat fee and actual build time.
Build and sell vertical starter kits (e.g. a booking-app template, a marketplace template) pre-wired to Supabase.

steal_this: Build and sell one polished, narrow starter template (e.g. 'SaaS waitlist + auth + Stripe in one Supabase project') that founders can clone and launch in a day.
